name: crypto cipher round trip
source: import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer'; import { createCipheriv, createDecipheriv } from 'node:crypto'; function main(): void { const key = Buffer.alloc(32); const iv = Buffer.alloc(16); const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-cbc', key, iv); cipher.update('hello'); const encrypted = cipher.final(); const decipher = createDecipheriv('aes-256-cbc', key, iv); decipher.update(encrypted); console.log(decipher.final().toString()); }
